mapper.sql: m.id AS meter_id, m.meter_code, m.meter_name, m.slave_address, b.box_code, b.box_name, m.is_toolbar, s.site_code, s.site_name

rl.voltage_a, rl.voltage_b, rl.voltage_c, rl.voltage_ab, rl.voltage_bc, rl.voltage_ca, rl.current_a, rl.current_b, rl.current_c, rl.active_power_total, rl.reactive_power_total, rl.apparent_power_total, rl.power_factor_total, rl.frequency, rl.data_quality, COALESCE(ms.last_collect_time, rl.collect_time) AS last_collect_time, ms.last_publish_time, ms.status_code AS meter_status_code, ms.is_online

FROM meter m LEFT JOIN distribution_box b ON b.id = m.box_id LEFT JOIN site s ON s.id = m.site_id LEFT JOIN meter_realtime_latest rl ON rl.meter_id = m.id LEFT JOIN meter_status ms ON ms.meter_id = m.id

WHERE IFNULL(m.is_enabled, 1) = 1
AND m.id = #{meterId}
AND m.meter_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{meterName}, '%')
AND m.meter_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{meterCode}, '%')
AND s.site_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{siteCode}, '%')
AND s.site_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{siteName}, '%')
AND b.box_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{boxCode}, '%')
AND b.box_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{boxName}, '%')
mapper.select:
SELECT , , rl.collect_time AS data_collect_time
WHERE IFNULL(m.is_enabled, 1) = 1 ORDER BY m.is_toolbar DESC, m.slave_address ASC, m.id ASC

SELECT , , rl.collect_time AS data_collect_time
ORDER BY m.is_toolbar DESC, m.slave_address ASC, m.id ASC

SELECT , , el.collect_time AS data_collect_time, el.forward_active_energy, el.reverse_active_energy, el.forward_reactive_energy, el.reverse_reactive_energy
LEFT JOIN meter_energy_latest el ON el.meter_id = m.id
ORDER BY m.is_toolbar DESC, m.slave_address ASC, m.id ASC

SELECT , , ql.collect_time AS data_collect_time, ql.current_thd_a, ql.current_thd_b, ql.current_thd_c, ql.voltage_thd_a, ql.voltage_thd_b, ql.voltage_thd_c, ql.voltage_unbalance, ql.current_unbalance
LEFT JOIN meter_power_quality_latest ql ON ql.meter_id = m.id
ORDER BY m.is_toolbar DESC, m.slave_address ASC, m.id ASC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT h.collect_time AS data_collect_time, h.collect_time AS last_collect_time, h.voltage_a, h.voltage_b, h.voltage_c, h.current_a, h.current_b, h.current_c, h.active_power_total, h.reactive_power_total, h.apparent_power_total, h.power_factor_total, h.frequency FROM meter_realtime_history h WHERE h.meter_id = #{meterId} AND h.collect_time >= #{beginTime} AND h.collect_time <= #{endTime} ORDER BY h.collect_time DESC LIMIT 240 ) trend_points ORDER BY data_collect_time

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT h.collect_time AS data_collect_time, h.collect_time AS last_collect_time, h.forward_active_energy, h.reverse_active_energy, h.forward_reactive_energy, h.reverse_reactive_energy FROM meter_energy_history h WHERE h.meter_id = #{meterId} AND h.collect_time >= #{beginTime} AND h.collect_time <= #{endTime} ORDER BY h.collect_time DESC LIMIT 240 ) trend_points ORDER BY data_collect_time

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT h.collect_time AS data_collect_time, h.collect_time AS last_collect_time, h.current_thd_a, h.current_thd_b, h.current_thd_c, h.voltage_thd_a, h.voltage_thd_b, h.voltage_thd_c, h.voltage_unbalance, h.current_unbalance FROM meter_power_quality_history h WHERE h.meter_id = #{meterId} AND h.collect_time >= #{beginTime} AND h.collect_time <= #{endTime} ORDER BY h.collect_time DESC LIMIT 240 ) trend_points ORDER BY data_collect_time

SELECT , h.voltage_a, h.voltage_b, h.voltage_c, h.voltage_ab, h.voltage_bc, h.voltage_ca, h.current_a, h.current_b, h.current_c, h.active_power_total, h.reactive_power_total, h.apparent_power_total, h.power_factor_total, h.frequency, h.collect_time AS data_collect_time, h.collect_time AS last_collect_time FROM meter_realtime_history h INNER JOIN meter m ON m.id = h.meter_id LEFT JOIN distribution_box b ON b.id = m.box_id LEFT JOIN site s ON s.id = m.site_id
ORDER BY h.collect_time DESC, m.id ASC

SELECT h.meter_id AS meterId, h.collect_time AS collectTime, h.forward_active_energy AS forwardActiveEnergy FROM meter_energy_history h WHERE h.collect_time >= #{beginTime} AND h.collect_time <= #{endTime} AND h.forward_active_energy IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.meter_id, h.collect_time

SELECT , , rl.collect_time AS data_collect_time, el.forward_active_energy, el.reverse_active_energy, el.forward_reactive_energy, el.reverse_reactive_energy, ql.current_thd_a, ql.current_thd_b, ql.current_thd_c, ql.voltage_thd_a, ql.voltage_thd_b, ql.voltage_thd_c, ql.voltage_unbalance, ql.current_unbalance
LEFT JOIN meter_energy_latest el ON el.meter_id = m.id LEFT JOIN meter_power_quality_latest ql ON ql.meter_id = m.id WHERE m.id = #{meterId} LIMIT 1
